items.title: Celebrities in Gucci at the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala
items.summary: Critic Catherine Kallon reviews roughly 16 celebrity looks in Gucci at the Nov 7 LACMA gala honoring Vija Celmins and Denis Villeneuve, praising Demna's black feathered gown on Soo Joo Park but noting Emily Ratajkowski's silhouette felt repetitive, something she has "worn a thousand times."

items.title: Who Made the Best Dressed at the 2026 LACMA Gala
items.summary: WWD best/worst-dressed roundup of the Gucci-sponsored LACMA gala; Rosie Huntington-Whiteley's dramatically backless Gucci gown drew mixed reactions with some critics calling it "tacky," while Kim Kardashian's cut-out burgundy sequin Gucci look was framed as a stronger execution of Demna's provocative direction.

items.title: It's Time! Mariah Carey Kicks Off Holiday Season with Gucci Party in New York
items.summary: Report on Mariah Carey's Nov 2 NYC cocktail party debuting her Gucci holiday campaign, featuring an a capella choir performing her Christmas anthem; event coverage frames Gucci's NA activation strategy of pairing a major campaign drop with an in-person press/influencer moment in the brand's most resilient regional market.

items.title: Kering Group Q3 Earnings 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Misses
items.summary: WWD's earnings writeup confirms Gucci's comparable sales fell 6% in Q3 2026 against a consensus estimate of -3.3%, with directly operated retail down 9%; North America slowed sharply to -10% comparable growth in Q3 from +10% in Q2, even though conversion, average price and ticket size kept improving there relative to Asia-Pacific. Retained past the 7-day freshness mark because it remains the active financial narrative framing all November NA coverage of Gucci's turnaround.

items.title: "2026 Gucci Flora" discussion thread
items.summary: Active PurseForum Gucci subforum thread where US members discuss the new Flora-print capsule (coated-canvas tote around $2,100, Ophidia Flora pouch $930); reception to material quality in person is largely positive ("most vibrant Flora they've done to-date") but some members flag the print as a narrow two-season item and question long-term value given the price point.

items.title: "Demna's Fashion Show Premier" discussion thread
items.summary: PurseForum members continue debating Demna's design direction for Gucci, with recurring complaints that silhouettes and styling repeat across seasons and skepticism about whether the "sexmaxxing" aesthetic suits the brand's traditional US clientele versus younger shoppers drawn in by the LACMA/celebrity push.

items.title: Gucci birthday-gift unboxing video (#guccipursereview)
items.summary: TikTok unboxing/ASMR video of a Gucci bag received as a birthday/graduation gift, tagged #guccibag #designerbags and geared toward gift-economy content; representative of the steady volume of organic (non-sponsored) US consumer unboxing content that keeps Gucci visible in TikTok's gifting/haul niche. View/like counts not exposed via public fetch.

items.title: [GUCCI X MARIAH CAREY] Gucci Gift 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: Official upload of the Harmony Korine-directed Gucci Gift 2026 holiday film starring Mariah Carey, released Nov 2 simultaneously across Gucci's and Carey's Instagram/YouTube channels; public view/like/comment counts were not retrievable via public fetch (YouTube stat blocks are not exposed to unauthenticated tools), so engagement is recorded null rather than estimated.

items.title: ICYMI: 2026 CFDA Fashion Award Winners, Pierpaolo Piccioli Exits Balenciaga & The Met Reveals Its Next Costume Institute Exhibit
items.summary: Fashionista's weekly industry roundup covering Balenciaga's Nov 5 split with creative director Pierpaolo Piccioli (replaced by Martine Rose) alongside other sector news; used here to anchor competitor mention counts for Balenciaga rather than as Gucci-specific coverage.

items.title: Louis Vuitton's 2026 Holiday Campaign Celebrates Train Travel
items.summary: WWD covers Louis Vuitton's 2026 holiday campaign themed around train travel and reunions; used as a direct comparison point to Gucci's own Mariah Carey holiday push and to anchor Louis Vuitton mention counts for the competitive-share tracker this cycle.

items.title: Prada Group Delivers 9M Growth in 2026, Miu Miu Slows Down Against High Comps
items.summary: WWD reports Prada Group's nine-month 2026 revenue grew 12%, lifted by strong Americas retail performance, while Miu Miu's growth slowed to 1% with a 3% Q3 retail decline; used to anchor Prada/Miu Miu mention counts and as a direct NA-market contrast to Gucci's regional deceleration.

items.title: Gucci Resale Value: Do Bags Hold Up? (2026 Guide)
items.summary: Resale-market analysis finding Gucci bags typically retain 55-70% of retail value versus 85-95%+ for Hermès and 70-85% for Chanel; flags the GG Marmont and plain-leather GG Supreme Dionysus as weak performers sitting well below retail on the secondary market, a critical-angle data point on value retention relevant to US resale buyers (The RealReal, Fashionphile).

items.title: The $1,000 Gucci T-Shirt Problem
items.summary: Adweek analysis arguing Gucci's post-pandemic price increases were too aggressive and often unjustified by craftsmanship, leaving the brand in a "muddle in the middle" charging Hermès-adjacent prices without Hermès-level exclusivity; cites US consumers questioning the value proposition of basic logo items priced over $1,000, with the brand losing shoppers in both directions (down-trading and up-trading away).

items.title: X live-search stream on Gucci LACMA gala reactions
items.summary: Live X search surfaces a mix of fan posts praising Demna's gowns (particularly on Soo Joo Park and Alex Consani) alongside posts mocking Rosie Huntington-Whiteley's backless look as try-hard; volume skews toward fashion-commentary accounts and red-carpet aggregator reposts rather than brand-owned content, consistent with organic event buzz. Individual post engagement counts not captured due to X's unauthenticated search-result rendering.

items.title: @gucci Instagram feed activity around LACMA and holiday campaign
items.summary: Gucci's official Instagram (50.6M followers) has been posting LACMA gala red-carpet content and Mariah Carey holiday-campaign stills this week; third-party analytics (Hypeauditor/Boomsocial) put the account's typical engagement rate near 0.02%, averaging roughly 9.9K likes and 83 comments per post, well below the brand's follower-base scale. Exact per-post like/comment counts for this week's specific posts were not independently retrievable without an authenticated connector, so recorded null rather than estimated.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci subforum - active thread index
items.summary: PurseForum's dedicated Gucci subforum index shows concurrent active threads this week on the Flora capsule, Demna's show direction, and a recurring "books about Gucci" culture thread, indicating steady but niche enthusiast engagement rather than a single viral spike; forum-wide tone remains split between appreciation for craftsmanship and recurring price/value skepticism carried over from the price-increase thread tracked in prior cycles.
